movementRule: One movement is one transfer between locations: port to rig, rig to port, or rig to rig. Repositioning at the rig already occupied does not count, nor does a shift between two port-side locations.

dataNotes: Trips as IN and OUT. CA1 3 IN / 2 OUT, CA3 2 IN / 2 OUT, CA5 2 IN / 3 OUT, Charlie-3 10 IN / 10 OUT. The OUT figure is used for each vessel. The IN and OUT totals are both 17.
OPH is not shown from this week. It is off hired, and the email no longer reports it.

The Truck sheet counts empty outbound legs. On 23.10 it counts the trucks sent out empty to collect (E18, E21) as OUT, and their loaded returns (E19, E22) as IN. Report 29 counted only the loaded leg. On 25.10 it counts three trucks sent to PS and brought back (E47 to E49) as OUT only.
Nine trucks or seven. E95 (28.10) says nine day-hired trucks arrived with 55 joints of 24" casing; E102 says seven trucks were offloaded with the same 55 joints. The Truck sheet's 17 in follows nine.

CA1 water on 23.10 and 24.10. Port E31 records 612 m³ 'drill and fresh water' on 23.10. Vessel E8 records 231 drill and 153 fresh on 23.10, and E12 204 drill on 24.10. The Port total is used: 153 fresh and 459 drill. If the 24.10 204 m³ is a separate bunkering, drill water is 1,635, not 1,431.
Charlie-3 fresh water on 23.10: 36 or 19 m³. Port E30 records 36; Vessel E11 records 19. 36 is used.

Bunkerings on the Vessel sheet only: CA3 612 m³ of drill water (28.10, the same figure as Port E31's CA1 bunkering), and all three fuel bunkerings: CA1 71.998 (24.10), CA5 36.006 (25.10) and Charlie-3 36.006 (27.10).
The Vessel sheet's date column reads '22.10.202' to '26.10.202'. Truncated; the Port sheet and the Truck sheet give the full dates.
headline: OD1 is laying down 38" cut joints. Last week the 38" and 36" casing was run and cemented.

One truck arrived from COSL Mina Abdallah with three lifts of HWDP and DC for OD1 (call-off OD-SH1R-B-5-3), per delivery ticket COSL-DT-OD-SH1R-B-5-3B.

Nine day-hired trucks arrived at Shuaiba Port from KOC Yard 4 with 55 joints of 24" 203 ppf L80 TSHERR-3 casing (CAT 70126893), a 26-3/4" x 21-1/4" drilling adapter and a 26-3/4" casing spool, delivered to the Shuaiba pipe yard.
The Al Mansoori team inspected 30 of the 55 joints of 24" R3 casing (CAT ID 70126893): 29 accepted and 1 rejected.
One truck loaded with two 36" x 38" crossover joints, sent to the Shuaiba pipe yard and offloaded there.
Two trucks loaded with 30" MLS equipment and casing accessories at the Shuaiba pipe yard.
Cargo operation with CA1: 21 backload cargo lifts offloaded (RCM-OD-696), and the deck arranged and prepared for the 30" casing joints, MLS equipment and casing accessories.
Cargo operation with CA1: 40 joints of 30" 234.51 ppf X-56 XLW-M70 R-3 casing with a float shoe and a float collar, and 4 joints of 30" 196.26 ppf X-56 XLW-M70 R-3 casing, loaded on deck.

The full 30" casing package loaded on CA1: 22 joints R3 196.26 ppf (CAT ID 70126875), 3 joints R2 196.26 ppf (70126877), 5 joints R1 196.26 ppf (70126876), 3 joints R2 234.5 ppf (70126884), 3 joints R1 234.5 ppf (70126883), 2 × 5 ft pup joints (70126878), 2 × 10 ft pup joints (70126879), 2 × 15 ft pup joints (70126880) and a 196.26 × 234.5 ppf crossover joint (70126886).
Seven trucks offloaded at the pipe yard with 55 joints of 24" R3 casing (CAT ID 70126893).
